comment: The QI migration file names, each stamped with its real creation time (UTC, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) the first time the ship-phase generator wrote it. A name never changes once stamped; a capstone migration for a tier whose engines pass the gate later is stamped then, by gen_course.py --stamp <tier>. The apply script orders the files explicitly (the course row first, the deep seeds, the later capstones, the go-live last), so a later stamp on a capstone file never reorders the ladder.
